description: This file contains the implementation of the Uri class which models and manipulates URI objects in compliance with the PSR-7 UriInterface. It provides methods to retrieve and modify components like scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment, ensuring proper encoding and parsing. The class is designed to be immutable, returning new instances on modification, and includes internal utility methods for URI validation and construction.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Psr\Http\Message\UriInterface, representing an immutable URI object with methods to access and modify URI components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Uri instance, optionally parsing a provided URI string.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Resets the cached URI string when the object is cloned.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI, generating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI scheme (e.g., http, https).

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Constructs and returns the authority component of the URI, including user info, host, and port.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info component of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number if non-standard; otherwise null.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component of the URI.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query component of the URI.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component of the URI.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified user info and optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Parses a URI string into components and sets the Uri instance properties.

methods.name: createUriString
methods.description: Constructs a URI string from individual URI components.

methods.name: isNonStandardPort
methods.description: Determines if the port is non-standard for the given scheme and host.

methods.name: filterScheme
methods.description: Validates and filters a scheme string.

methods.name: filterUserInfoPart
methods.description: Encodes user info parts for URI compliance.

methods.name: filterPath
methods.description: Encodes the path component to ensure proper URI encoding.

methods.name: filterInvalidUtf8
methods.description: Ensures strings contain valid UTF-8 characters, encoding invalid ones.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Encodes and constructs a query string for URI compliance.

methods.name: splitQueryValue
methods.description: Splits a query parameter into key and value.

methods.name: filterFragment
methods.description: Encodes the fragment part of the URI.

methods.name: filterQueryOrFragment
methods.description: Encodes query or fragment components.

methods.name: urlEncodeChar
methods.description: Encodes a matched character into its URL-encoded form.
